_metadata.description: Exposure-query API for app-monitor: answer is-<scenario>-exposed and create-lease-and-return-tunnel-URL, backing app-monitor's open-in-new-tab feature.

requirements.title: Answer whether a scenario is currently exposed
requirements.description: An IsExposed(scenario) query returns whether the scenario has an active (enabled, unexpired) route, for app-monitor to decide if an open-in-new-tab link is live.

requirements.title: Create a lease on demand and return the tunnel URL
requirements.description: ExposeAndGetURL(scenario) ensures a LEASED route exists (creating and ensure-running it if needed) and returns the resulting public tunnel URL for app-monitor's open-in-new-tab action.

requirements.title: Return a stable contract consumable by app-monitor
requirements.description: The exposure-query responses are proto-typed messages (scenario, exposed, public_url, lease expiry) so app-monitor consumes a stable contract rather than ad-hoc JSON.
